sloka: तत्र देवान्पितऽन्विप्रानर्चयित्वा यथाविधि ।बाह्यकक्षान्तरं रामो निर्जगाम जनैर्वृतः ।। ७.३७.१४ ॥
transliteration: tatra devānpita'nviprānarcayitvā yathāvidhi ।bāhyakakṣāntaraṁ rāmo nirjagāma janairvṛtaḥ ।। 7.37.14 ॥

translations.english: After duly worshipping the gods, ancestors, and Brahmins, Rama emerged into the outer chamber, surrounded by many people.
